bank.title: Bank details
bank.twoPersonNote: Every bank-detail change must be approved by a second, different person before it takes effect.
bank.queueIntro: You cannot approve a change you made yourself. Changes to an existing account, or requested by the vendor, need a callback to a known contact.
bank.callbackNeeded: Call the vendor on a number already on file and record the reference before approving.

admin.sodNote: Roles that would let one person both prepare and approve the same thing cannot be assigned together.
admin.authorityNote: Spending limits per legal entity. Approval rules are applied by the workflow engine in a later release.
